text: Create a pre-sprint client dependency checklist — all required credentials and API access must be confirmed before sprint planning begins
Escalate unresolved client blockers to Apex Bank PMO within 24 hours of first report, not at end-of-sprint
Document MFA integration pattern for Sprint 2 handover so no context is lost
All UI wizard stories must be broken into per-step sub-tasks before pointing — no wizard ticket to be pointed as a single item
DAST scan integration to be completed as Sprint 3 first priority — no further deferral accepted
Hold story refinement session for PHX-017 remaining work before Sprint 3 kick-off to prevent underestimation recurrence
Schedule requirements lock-in workshop in Week 1 of all future Deloitte digital projects — add to engagement delivery standards
Start pen-test activities no later than Sprint 2 of every project to allow full remediation time before UAT
Formally allocate 10% of each sprint capacity for technical debt reduction — add tech debt stories to the backlog
Create a frontend complexity checklist for sortable/filterable table tickets — include state management complexity flags in estimation
Add UAT performance benchmark (p95 < 1s) to the project Definition of Done — must be verified before client UAT sign-off
Introduce fortnightly frontend-backend integration sync meeting to catch contract mismatches earlier in the sprint
